decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD costs almost nothing to keep listed in a music retailer's catalogue, and as long as some residual demand exists, the option to sell it is worth more than the negligible saving from delisting it.

The illustrated release series has been shown for two years and still holds option value for further releases, while keeping it costs little, so abandonment is not yet justified despite the uncertainty since 2020.
Reissued jazz vinyl benefits from the ongoing vinyl revival and has durable catalogue value, so the low-cost option should be kept open.
A multi-disc box set is a collector item with long-tail demand and minimal holding cost once produced, so the firm keeps it available until stock runs out.

The compilation CD was only mentioned and never given a page of its own, signalling weak commitment, and physical compilation CDs are in structural decline, so the evidence points to abandoning this marginal option.
